name: Icon Button
description: Compact native button for familiar commands. The icon is decorative, aria-label owns the accessible name, and pointer/focus states remain browser-derived.

props.name: icon
props.description: Required decorative icon content rendered inside the compact action target.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required native accessible name for the icon-only command; maps from Figma accessibleLabel.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native unavailable state using the HTML disabled attribute.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native 40 by 40 button element and interaction target.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Decorative 20 by 20 icon presentation centered inside the target.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover rendered with CSS; not a public state prop.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Active pointer/keyboard visual rendered with CSS; not a public state prop.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus indicator derived from browser focus-visible state.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Native HTML disabled state with disabled foreground styling.

semantics.accessibleName: Required native aria-label owns the accessible name; icon content is decorative and must not replace it.
requirements: Default type is button when consumer omits type.
Target remains exactly 40 by 40 CSS pixels in the base component contract.
Icon presentation remains 20 by 20 and is hidden from the accessibility tree.
Native disabled uses the disabled attribute and suppresses activation.
No loading state or loading API exists in version 1.0.0.

icon.description: Required decorative icon content supplied by the consumer.
